decisive_items: Admixed atypical, irregularly contoured lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes
T-cell receptor PCR: Matching clonal rearrangements identified in 3 skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample
response.rationale: The biopsy shows atypical lymphocytes with clonal TCR rearrangements in skin and marrow, supporting a cutaneous T-cell lymphoma. R1 (Sézary syndrome) is less specific because it requires erythroderma and blood Sézary cells, which are absent; R3 (mycosis fungoides) is a subtype but here the infiltrate is nodular/diffuse with prominent CD8 signal, less typical of classic MF; R4 lacks clonal and immunophenotypic detail.

rejected.why: No erythroderma or Sézary cells; bone marrow phenotype CD8-dominant is unusual for Sézary syndrome.
Nodular/diffuse infiltrate and CD8 dominance are not classic for mycosis fungoides; MF typically epidermotropic, CD4-dominant.
Lymphomatoid papulosis usually self-limited, with CD30+ cells; not described and lacks clonal bone marrow involvement.
